stories.title: Burnham meets Canadian PM Carney for first bilateral
stories.summary: Andy Burnham and Mark Carney held their first in-person bilateral meeting, covering AI safety, defence cooperation, critical minerals, and energy security — culminating in a trip to watch Everton in the Carabao Cup.

stories.title: Fashion firms urge Burnham to make NHS and military uniforms in UK
stories.summary: UK fashion industry leaders called on PM Andy Burnham to prioritise domestic manufacturing of NHS and Ministry of Defence uniforms as part of an industrial revival push.

stories.title: Data centres to drive Burnham's 'growth in every postcode' pledge
stories.summary: PM Burnham's commitment to regional growth is being linked to the government's prominent backing of data centre expansion across the UK.

topics.name: Burnham Gov Intelligence
topics.description: Procurement, tech/AI, spending, vendor & priority signals

stories.title: 🤖 Louise Haigh warns UK must heed AI experts — calls for G20 regulation
stories.summary: First Secretary Louise Haigh told the TUC conference there are 'huge risks to national security' from AI without guardrails, backing calls for Burnham to use the UK's G20 presidency to drive global AI regulation.

stories.title: 🤖 HMRC deploys AI to categorise businesses by 'propensity to pay' tax debts
stories.summary: HMRC has deployed artificial intelligence to score businesses on their likelihood of paying tax debts, marking a significant step in AI-enabled revenue collection.

stories.title: 🏗️ Government plans £65m deal for public sector Earth observation data
stories.summary: The UK government is planning a £65m public sector framework deal for Earth observation data access, with implications for planning, environment and defence procurement.

stories.title: 🤖 DSIT committee chair: 'Leaving tech regulation to market has not worked'
stories.summary: The Science and Technology Committee chair declared that market self-regulation of technology has failed and called for greater government intervention in tech oversight.

stories.title: 🤖 GOV.UK One Login introduces NCSC-backed biometric passkeys
stories.summary: GOV.UK One Login is rolling out biometric passkey sign-in to millions more users, with the National Cyber Security Centre endorsing the move as a phishing-resistant upgrade.

topics.description: House of Commons, Lords, PMQs, legislation

stories.title: Abena Oppong-Asare elected Chair of Housing Select Committee
stories.summary: The Speaker announced that Abena Oppong-Asare MP has been elected Chair of the Housing, Communities and Local Government Select Committee.

stories.title: MPs debate assisted dying bill — personal testimony highlights
stories.summary: MPs recounted personal experiences as the House continued debate on the assisted dying bill, which recently failed to pass in the Commons.

topics.name: Labour Party
topics.description: Labour Party news, policy, internal politics

stories.title: No 10: Pensioners on state pension only should not pay income tax
stories.summary: The PM's spokesperson confirmed that those whose only income is the state pension should not pay income tax during this parliament, despite the pension expected to rise to around £13,000.

stories.title: Union leaders resist political donations cap after Reform's £72m crypto haul
stories.summary: Trade union leaders pushed back against proposed donation caps, arguing it would 'Americanise' UK politics — even as Reform UK received £72m from two crypto-billionaires in one weekend.

stories.title: Labour MPs urge Burnham to use G20 presidency for global AI regulation
stories.summary: Labour MPs and peers called on PM Burnham to put AI governance on the agenda for the UK-hosted G20 summit in 2027, with warnings against a 'classic Westminster' over-regulatory response.

stories.title: Badenoch responds to Reform Wales leader arrest
stories.summary: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said 'people are innocent until proven guilty' after Reform UK's Welsh leader Dan Thomas was arrested on suspicion of assault and stood down.

stories.title: Farage's £72m crypto donations intensify pressure for Tory donor rule reform
stories.summary: The massive Reform donation is prompting calls for sweeping reform of political donation rules, creating pressure on both Labour and the Conservatives to respond legislatively.

stories.title: Ed Davey: 'Major deterrent' needed to end small boat Channel crossings
stories.summary: Liberal Democrat leader Sir Ed Davey called for a major deterrent against small boat crossings, criticising the government's migration approach as insufficient.

stories.title: Davey backs Cleveland Police demand for £20m extra per year
stories.summary: The Lib Dem leader supported Cleveland Police's call for £20m in additional government funding annually to hire hundreds more officers.

stories.title: Community hospital cuts could cause 'long-lasting damage' — Davey
stories.summary: Ed Davey warned that cuts to community hospitals in rural Wales could cause serious and lasting damage to local healthcare provision.

topics.name: Reform UK
topics.description: Nigel Farage, Reform UK party news

stories.title: Welsh Reform leader quits after arrest on suspicion of assault
stories.summary: Dan Thomas, leader of Reform UK in Wales, resigned after being arrested on suspicion of assault, in a damaging development for the party during the £72m donations row.

stories.title: £72m crypto-donation row: Government proposes enhanced donor residency rules
stories.summary: Following Reform UK receiving £72m from two crypto-billionaires (Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne), the government proposed an 'enhanced residency test' for political donors; Farage says donations are '100% compliant with the law today'.

stories.title: 'Significant unease' at Telegraph over Reform's spoiler tactics
stories.summary: Journalists at the Daily Telegraph expressed concern that Reform UK is using the newspaper as a vehicle for political spoiler campaigns against other parties.

stories.title: Taoiseach warns Sinn Féin-SNP alliance may harm Irish unity
stories.summary: Irish Taoiseach Micheál Martin suggested that Sinn Féin aligning with the SNP and Welsh independence parties could set back the cause of Irish unity.

stories.title: Nicola Sturgeon reported to police for allegedly handling stolen goods
stories.summary: Former SNP First Minister Nicola Sturgeon has been reported to police on suspicion of handling stolen goods, adding to ongoing legal pressures from the SNP finances investigation.

stories.title: Scottish Labour leadership candidates pressed on free tuition by SNP
stories.summary: SNP politicians are pressing Scottish Labour's leadership candidates to publicly state their positions on free university tuition ahead of the leadership contest.

stories.title: Government introduces Repeal Bill to remove religious restrictions on Prime Ministers
stories.summary: The Church Appointments (Repeal of Discriminatory Provision) Bill will enable Roman Catholic or Jewish Prime Ministers to advise the King on Church of England appointments, removing archaic 18th–19th century restrictions.

topics.description: Upcoming or recent election results, polls

stories.title: Piddington village holds symbolic vote on independence from UK
stories.summary: The Northamptonshire village of Piddington held a symbolic vote on seeking independence from the United Kingdom, gaining national media attention.

stories.title: Commentary: Too many polls are turning politics into a game
stories.summary: A Guardian commentator argues the proliferation of political polls is reducing democratic debate to a spectator sport, particularly as Reform UK's polling surge dominates coverage.
